say:3:1064404001:0.text: Brrr... It's freezing out here! Raymond, toss another log on the fire before your fingers freeze stiff!
say:3:1064404001:0.source_cn: 嘶——呼——这鬼天气……莱默尔，火快灭了，添把柴，别把...

say:5:1064404003:1.text: Beyond the horizon, a dense swarm of dark figures approaches. Their bloodcurdling howls precede them.
say:5:1064404003:1.source_cn: 地平线外，浓稠的黑暗浪潮向安息城推进，非人的嘶吼随风声而来。

say:7:1064404005:0.text: As the horn blares, pounding footsteps and shouted commands erupt from every corner of the city walls.
say:7:1064404005:0.source_cn: 号角吹响，冬夜里，脚步奔跑声、军官嘶吼声，交织碰撞。

say:11:1064404006:0.text:
Stay in formation! Stick to the battle plan!
Nock your arrows and spill the oil! Fire on my command!
say:11:1064404006:0.source_cn: 稳住阵线！记住演练内容！\n箭矢上弦，火油准备，等待我...

say:12:1064404007:0.text: Thanks to the numerous drills, the soldiers quickly snap out of their daze and move into position with practiced precision.
say:12:1064404007:0.source_cn: 得益于提前部署，士兵们很快从短暂的惊愕中回过神来，有条...

say:13:1064404008:0.text: The dark swarm turns out to be a horde of grotesque, humanoid monsters. The moment they reach the city walls, they begin scaling them.
say:13:1064404008:0.source_cn: 黑暗浪潮的轮廓终于清晰：那是由形态扭曲的类人形生物组成...

say:14:1064404009:0.source_cn: 放箭！\n让这些杂碎在雪中淬火！

say:16:1064404010:0.text: Flaming arrows rain down, landing squarely in the oil pooled at the Hypofiends' feet. As the flames roar to life, anguished wails echo through the winter night.
say:16:1064404010:0.source_cn: 火箭离弦，准确地扎入魔物脚下的火油中，火焰升腾，雪夜中...

say:17:1064404011:0.text: Though the first wave of Hypofiends has faltered, countless more press on, undeterred by the hail of arrows.
say:17:1064404011:0.source_cn: 第一波冲击受挫，但魔物的数量依然惊人。它们顶着箭雨，继...

say:18:1064404012:0.text:
Drop the boulders!
Smash their bones to dust!
say:18:1064404012:0.source_cn: 推石！\n我不信他们的骨头比野猪还硬！

say:19:1064404013:0.text: Massive boulders tumble from the walls, crushing the Hypofiends in their path. Yet the survivors remain unfazed. Trampling over the remains of their fallen comrades, they press on.
say:19:1064404013:0.source_cn: 巨型滚石将城墙上的魔物砸倒，但它们似乎不会感到恐惧，踩...

say:21:1064404014:0.text: Hours later, countless frozen corpses have piled up outside Resford.
say:21:1064404014:0.source_cn: 战斗持续了数小时，风雪呼号，数不尽的尸骸堆叠，在极寒的...

say:22:1064404015:0.text: At last, the Hypofiends cease their assault. Many soldiers are still visibly rattled, yet their eyes gleam with the relief of having survived.
say:22:1064404015:0.source_cn: 魔物的第一波攻势终于退去，许多士兵挂着惊魂未定的神情，...

say:25:1064404016:0.text: W-We made it! Resford is safe!
say:25:1064404016:0.source_cn: 我们、我们赢了！安息城守住了！

say:26:1064404017:0.text: It's too early to celebrate! That was only the beginning. The real challenge is yet to come!
say:26:1064404017:0.source_cn: 冷静！这只是一次试探，真正的风暴尚未到来！

say:27:1064404018:0.text: Take stock of the casualties. Replenish the arrows and boulders. Stay alert, everyone!
say:27:1064404018:0.source_cn: 清点伤亡，补充箭矢滚石。所有人，保持警惕！

narration:33:1064404020:0.text: The next three days see Resford become a sea of blood.
narration:33:1064404020:0.source_cn: 接下来三天，安息城陷入血色风暴中……

say:35:1064404021:0.text: Day and night, the Hypofiends attack without pause. Flying Hypofiends rain acid from above, while gigantic ones hurl themselves against the city gates again and again.
say:35:1064404021:0.source_cn: 魔物不分昼夜地发动攻击，潮水般的冲锋混杂着难以预料的偷...

say:36:1064404022:0.text: Under Alna's command, the soldiers hold off wave after wave of Hypofiends. But each victory comes at a cost as casualties mount and supplies dwindle.
say:36:1064404022:0.source_cn: 在阿尔娜的指挥下，顽强的守军一次次击退魔物，但伤亡数量...

say:37:1064404023:0.text: After Lord Sno repeatedly refuses her requests for reinforcements, Alna has no choice but to ask other cities for help...
say:37:1064404023:0.source_cn: 阿尔娜多次派人向领主寻求援助，均遭到拒绝，她只能派出多...

say:42:1064404024:0.text: General, none of our five scout teams made it back... It's crawling with Hypofiends out there! There's no way we can get help from the other cities!
say:42:1064404024:0.source_cn: 将军，派出去的五队兄弟，都没回来……城外到处都是魔物，...

say:43:1064404025:0.text: None of our soldiers have abandoned their posts, but we're running low on medicine and weapons...
say:43:1064404025:0.source_cn: 没有一个士兵离开阵地，但药物、武器已经快见底了……

say:44:1064404026:0.text: Frustrated, Alna slams her fist against the city wall. Then, a thunderous roar in the distance plunges her into even deeper despair. It comes from the Hypogean, a creature far stronger and more intelligent than any Hypofiend.
say:44:1064404026:0.source_cn: 阿尔娜愤然锤向城墙，更绝望的是，城外传来声音，它来自比...

say:48:1064404027:0.text:
Heed the will of the abyss, weaklings!
Tomorrow, we unleash our full might! I'll reduce this city to rubble and tear every soul apart!
say:48:1064404027:0.source_cn: 脆弱的蝼蚁，聆听深渊的意志！\n明日，总攻开始！我将踏...

say:49:1064404028:0.text: Consider this my mercy. Open the gates and surrender now, and I'll let you live.
say:49:1064404028:0.source_cn: 但，仁慈的深渊，给予你们一个选择——立刻打开城门，跪地...

say:52:1064404029:1.text: Alna looks over her shoulder. Some soldiers tighten their grip on their weapons, while others curse under their breath. Yet none of them leave the line.
say:52:1064404029:1.source_cn: 阿尔娜望向身后，有人沉默地握紧武器，有人低声咒骂，但队...

say:53:1064404030:1.text:
This is what I like to see, soldiers!
As long as we stand, Resford will never fall!
say:53:1064404030:1.source_cn: 好样的，士兵们！\n今夜，明日，每一刻，安息城，永不陷落！

say:54:1064404031:1.text: Let's send this wicked Hypogean and its minions back to the abyss!
say:54:1064404031:1.source_cn: 与我一起，把恶魔和它的渣滓们送回深渊！

say:55:1064404032:0.text: Alna understands that morale alone cannot win the battle. Leaving her deputy in command, she seeks out Lord Sno to secure more supplies.
say:55:1064404032:0.source_cn: 阿尔娜明白，仅靠军队顽强的意志，不足以赢得战争。她安排...

say:59:1064404034:0.text: General Alna, His Lordship is so worried about the city that he has fallen ill. I'm afraid this isn't a suitable time to disturb him.
say:59:1064404034:0.source_cn: 阿尔娜将军，领主大人忧心城防，以致身体欠安，现在不便打扰呢。

say:60:1064404035:0.text:
I don't have time for your nonsense!
My soldiers are barely holding on! I need more supplies to sustain the fight!
say:60:1064404035:0.source_cn: 我没有时间与你玩弄唇舌！\n士兵在流血，我需要物资援助！

say:61:1064404036:0.text: We cannot simply allocate resources without careful deliberation! Lord Sno wouldn't want his wealth wasted on—
say:61:1064404036:0.source_cn: 您此前一意孤行，物资派遣自然得多加考量，领主大人的财富...

say:67:1064404038:1.text: Alna wipes the blood from her spear, steps over Pantheus' lifeless body, and heads deeper into the castle.
say:67:1064404038:1.source_cn: 阿尔娜抹去枪上的鲜血，迈过平图斯的尸体，走向城堡深处。

say:68:1064404039:0.text: Lord Sno is nowhere to be found in the castle. A secret passage leading beyond the city has collapsed into a heap of rubble, and the air still carries the faint scent of gunpowder.
say:68:1064404039:0.source_cn: 城堡各处不见领主踪影，只有一条通往城外的密道，此时已被...

say:69:1064404040:0.text: Looks like Lord Sno made his escape, then blew up the passage behind him to cover his tracks.
say:69:1064404040:0.source_cn: 看来，为了防止追击，领主在逃跑后已将地道炸毁。

say:70:1064404041:0.text: You. Bring me to the vault!

say:72:1064404042:0.text: His Lordship... I mean, Sno took everything in the vault with him before he fled...
say:72:1064404042:0.source_cn: 领主大人……不不，斯诺他、他在逃跑时，已经将财库搬空了……

say:73:1064404043:0.text: Did he take the glacite too?

say:74:1064404044:1.text: Y-Yes... Anything he couldn't take, he ordered us to burn it... Please don't kill me...
say:74:1064404044:1.source_cn: 是、是的……带不走的物资，他命令我们全部烧掉……求大人...

say:75:1064404045:0.text:
Shame on you!
Your cowardice will destroy Resford! You don't deserve to wear a soldier's uniform!
say:75:1064404045:0.source_cn: 耻辱！\n你们的胆怯，会摧毁安息城！愧为战士！

say:77:1064404046:0.text: Alna ignores the guard and returns to the front lines. She says nothing of Lord Sno's escape, unwilling to undermine the army's morale.
say:77:1064404046:0.source_cn: 阿尔娜没有理会下跪乞怜的守卫，她返回战线，下令封锁领主...

say:81:1064404048:0.text: Outside the city, the Hypofiends gather in silence, yet make no move to attack. Their Hypogean leader steps forward, dragging Lord Sno behind him.
say:81:1064404048:0.source_cn: 魔物军队不断集结，但似乎并不急于进攻。不久后，恶魔统领...

say:83:1064404049:0.text: Take a good look at this coward you've been serving all along!
say:83:1064404049:0.source_cn: 呵……看看你们所愚忠之人！

say:85:1064404050:0.text: I-I'm Lord Sno! Open the gates now! Do it, and they'll spare our lives!
say:85:1064404050:0.source_cn: 我、我是你们的领主！我命令你们，打开城门！它们答应了，...

say:89:1064404051:0.text: Is that... Lord Sno?! Shouldn't he be inside the city?
say:89:1064404051:0.source_cn: 那是……斯诺大人？！他不是在安息城里吗？

say:90:1064404052:0.text: I can't believe he'd give an order like that!
say:90:1064404052:0.source_cn: 身为领主，他怎么能说出这样的话！

say:94:1064404053:0.text: That man isn't our ruler! He's just a coward who has betrayed us all!
say:94:1064404053:0.source_cn: 那不是领主，只是一个叛誓的懦夫！

say:95:1064404054:0.text: Alna raises her bow and looses an arrow straight through Sno's throat.
say:95:1064404054:0.source_cn: 话音刚落，阿尔娜张弓搭箭，箭矢窜出，精准地贯穿领主咽喉。

say:99:1064404055:0.text: I, Alna, have executed the traitor for the people of Resford!
say:99:1064404055:0.source_cn: 我，阿尔娜，以安息城尊严的名义，已将叛城者处决！

say:100:1064404056:0.text: As Sno's body slumps to the ground, the Hypogean stares at it in stunned disbelief. Clearly, Alna's decisive action has caught him completely off guard.
say:100:1064404056:0.source_cn: 恶魔统领震惊地看向已无生气的领主，它没有想到阿尔娜会如...

say:101:1064404057:0.text: Lieutenant Dunn is the first to recover from the shock. He raises his sword, and the rest of the soldiers soon follow.
say:101:1064404057:0.source_cn: 军队先是出现短暂的静默，随后，副将邓恩率先举剑，余下士...

say:103:1064404059:0.text:
Rise, warriors of the northern lands!
Fight for Resford!
say:103:1064404059:0.source_cn: 向前，北地人！\n凛冬已至，为安息城奋战！

say:107:1064404060:1.text: This time, the Hypofiends attack with unprecedented ferocity. The walls are breached at multiple points, allowing the Hypofiends to pour into the city. The streets and plazas soon fill with the screams of terrified civilians.
say:107:1064404060:1.source_cn: 总攻比以往猛烈数倍，城墙多处失守，魔物们涌进安息城，街...

say:108:1064404061:0.text: Alna gives her all to defending the city, but she is no match for the Hypofiends... Resford, the city she vowed to protect, is falling...
say:108:1064404061:0.source_cn: 阿尔娜挥舞冰枪，但人类的力量难以抵抗魔潮……安息城，她...

say:109:1064404062:0.text: At that moment, Alna hears the Seed of Frost calling to her once again... <style="highlight">The time has come for her to merge with it</style>.
say:109:1064404062:0.source_cn: 这时，阿尔娜感到寒冰之种的呼唤再度出现，强盛空前……<...

say:112:1064404063:0.text: As long as there are soldiers left, these walls will never fall!
say:112:1064404063:0.source_cn: 安息城尚有战士，城墙……便不会倒下！

say:114:1064404064:0.text: The ancient power of winter surges into Alna's chest and courses through her veins... It freezes her blood, encases her bones in ice, and tears every muscle in her body apart...
say:114:1064404064:0.source_cn: 世界诞生之初的凛冬本源，从阿尔娜的胸口钻入，顺着血管蔓...

say:115:1064404065:0.text: Alna opens her mouth, but can't find her voice... Her throat has been sealed by snow.
say:115:1064404065:0.source_cn: 阿尔娜张开嘴，却发不出任何声音……她的喉咙已覆满冬雪。
